title: The Sunken Bell
text: A bell tolls under the black water, once every hundred heartbeats, a deep dull sound you feel in the chest. There is a rope on the bank, tied off to a post, leading down. It is taut. Every time the bell tolls, it jerks.

options.label: The strongest hauls the bell up, to learn what tolls it.

outcomes.text: A chapel bell, green with age. Its tone clears the head.
Something is holding the other end, and it lets go only when it is out of the water.

options.label: Cut the rope, and silence the bell for good.

outcomes.text: The bell stops. The marsh is very quiet after, and something below is very angry.
